changelog:
Dairy Market Report 3.0.0 is a major new release, now producing professional, magazine-style PDF dairy market intelligence reports in Chinese.

- Generates a unified, 12-section PDF report (乳制品市场行情报告) from monthly dairy industry PDFs and any supporting policy DOCX files.
- Delivers magazine-style layout: striking cover, two-column TOC, continuous-flow multipage body, KPI cards, banded data tables, color-coded change indicators, and AI insights.
- Automates GDT-to-warehouse landed cost calculations (AMF/WMP/SMP, contract-2) and embeds them into the report.
- Supports in-depth corporate, policy, and innovation coverage alongside raw milk prices, feed costs, domestic/foreign price comparisons, production, imports, and exports.
- All design tokens (colors, typography, structure) strictly follow a set style guide for consistent, executive-ready output.
- Workflow fully documented for multi-source extraction, data validation, and PDF generation; legacy HTML/CSS assets deprecated.
